structure.unit: Abandoned, Immobilized, Unattended and Trespassing Vehicles; Parking

law.catch_line: Limitation on removal and sale of abandoned vehicles
law.text: No person may remove or sell any abandoned vehicle left on public property or the shoulder of a primary highway unless such person is acting pursuant to an agreement for such removal or sale with a local government entity or law-enforcement agency and has actual possession of the vehicle.
